title: PAR-119/7BP GeoData target-version gate correction and no-tail downgrade refusal
mode: ODA specification-backed local implementation with generated vectors and focused strict/sanitizer validation
scope: Correct DRW_GeoData DWG CIVIL-tail selection to use the ODA target-version matrix in both reader and writer.
Replace AC1027-positive generated vectors with AC1027/AC1032 no-tail controls while retaining AC1021/AC1024 positives.
Prevent no-tail DWG output from silently discarding a retained or independently populated CIVIL-tail field.
Validate the owning object-vector and hardening targets without running the full suite or adding a drawing fixture.

changes: Added one translation-unit helper selecting the CIVIL tail for AC1021 and AC1024 only.
Used the shared predicate in DRW_GeoData::parseDwg and encodeDwg.
Added preflight refusal when a no-tail target would discard a present tail or any non-default tail field; refusal occurs before body, string, or handle buffer writes.
Reader vectors cover AC1021/AC1024 tail-positive and AC1027/AC1032 no-tail targets, including objectVersion 2/3 no-tail cases and body/handle sentinels.
Moved false-bit and truncated-tail/retry diagnostics to the valid AC1024 tail-bearing target.
Writer vectors assert exact literal tail bytes only for AC1021/AC1024 and exact no-tail body equality for AC1027/AC1032.
Added transactional down-target rejection for a retained source tail and for populated tail fields without the presence marker; clean no-tail objects remain encodable.

target_matrix.AC1024: tail present by the ODA AutoCAD 2010 exception

implementation.fixture_policy: No DWG/DXF fixture or CTest registration added; all vectors are generated in the existing object-vector test owner.

validation.diff_check: PASS for src/drw_objects.cpp, src/drw_objects.h, tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp, and DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

specification_and_limits.authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.78 says the tail follows mesh faces for DWG R21 or lower and separately notes that AutoCAD 2010 always writes Civil data.

The official ODA-published PDF search-index excerpt was consulted directly; the source is the same ODA document/version, not a third-party transcription.
specification_and_limits.remaining_boundary: This closes the local target-matrix correction only. Independent producer/native acceptance and the remaining parity-plan implementation work are still open. A no-tail downgrade with retained CIVIL data intentionally fails closed because no equivalent field mapping is established.
